// extraPaths: camera.py lives in colormixing/ and is imported as a bare 'from camera import ...' after run_health puts that dir on sys.path (_find_camera_dir). The legacy scripts import each other as bare siblings too.
// include: microdrop was missing here until 2026-08-20, so 2,747 lines of production code got no type checking at all -- and an editor opening one of its files analysed it outside the project scope, which is how built-ins came to be reported undefined.
// exclude: Specifying `exclude` at all REPLACES pyright's defaults rather than adding to them, so the first three entries below restore them: **/node_modules, **/__pycache__ and **/.* (which covers .venv, .git and every other dotted folder). .venv is also named explicitly because it is the one that actually costs something here -- analysing a Windows venv full of third-party packages would swamp the real findings. The last two are this repo's own: runs/ is experiment output and background/ holds images.
// pythonPlatform: The vendor DLL is Windows x64 and the venv is a Windows venv (.venv/Scripts). Analysing as Linux -- which is what running pyright under WSL infers -- hides the real target and flags Windows-only APIs like os.add_dll_directory, which actuation.py already guards with hasattr.
// reportMissingModuleSource: cv2 ships inline types but no stub package; not actionable.
